# Virtual Screening

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Butina Clustering

Cluster a SMILES library by whole-molecule or Murcko-scaffold fingerprints and optionally configure sampling and dimensionality reduction.

Exact job name: `Butina_Clustering`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV containing `SMILES`. Capital `P` is required. |
| `model` | string | yes | value | `Butina` or `Murcko-Butina`. |
| `DimReduce` | string | yes | value | Exact current UI values `PCA` or `tSNE`. Preserve case. |
| `sampling_type` | string | yes | value | Exact current UI values `Random` or `Min-Max`. Preserve case. It is still sent when `sampling` is `no`. |
| `cutoff` | number | yes | value | Clustering cutoff. `0.4` is end-to-end verified; `-1` is newly submission-accepted as an automatic/default sentinel, but its terminal semantics are not yet verified. |
| `sampling` | string | yes | value | Exact lowercase string `yes` or `no`, not a boolean. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "Path": {
      "description": "Uploaded CSV containing `SMILES`. Capital `P` is required.",
      "type": "string",

    },
    "model": {
      "description": "`Butina` or `Murcko-Butina`.",

        "Butina",

      ],

    },

      "type": "string",

        "PCA",
        "tSNE"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "sampling_type": {
      "description": "Exact current UI values `Random` or `Min-Max`. Preserve case. It is still sent when `sampling` is `no`.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "Random",
        "Min-Max"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },

      "description": "Clustering cutoff. `0.4` is end-to-end verified; `-1` is newly submission-accepted as an automatic/default sentinel, but its terminal semantics are not yet verified.",

      ],

    }
  },
```

## Novelty Check

Compare an uploaded SMILES library against a selected reference collection by exact identity or molecular similarity.

Exact job name: `Novelty`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV containing a case-sensitive `SMILES` column. |
| `library` | string | yes | value | Select the supported screening library. |
| `STRUCTURE_SEARCH` | string | yes | value | Exact API value `Identical` or `Similarity`. |
| `threshold` | number | yes | value | Similarity cutoff for `Similarity`; still send a numeric value for `Identical`, conventionally `0`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "description": "Uploaded CSV containing a case-sensitive `SMILES` column.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "library": {
      "description": "Select the supported screening library.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ChEMBL",
        "SureChEMBL",
        "Enamine"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "STRUCTURE_SEARCH": {
      "description": "Exact API value `Identical` or `Similarity`.",
      "type": "string",

        "Identical",
        "Similarity"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "threshold": {
      "description": "Similarity cutoff for `Similarity`; still send a numeric value for `Identical`, conventionally `0`.",
      "type": "number",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path",
    "library",
    "STRUCTURE_SEARCH",
    "threshold"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## QSPR Screening

Screen an uploaded molecule library against selected property or ADMET filters.

Exact job name: `QSPR_Screening`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV containing a case-sensitive `SMILES` column. Use lowercase `path`. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected custom models using the documented object fields below; use authorized model identifiers. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Legacy model-name selection. For the documented fixed-filter mode, use filters objects; do not infer threshold objects here. |
| `filters` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Fixed-filter objects emitted by the platform. Preserve exact value/type pairs. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "description": "Uploaded CSV containing a case-sensitive `SMILES` column. Use lowercase `path`.",

      "x-input-kind": "file"

    "custom_models": {
      "description": "Selected custom models using the documented object fields below; use authorized model identifiers.",
```
